description: Small wall ventilator: a cast-iron air grille 0.24 W x 0.16 H m with a moulded border and a lattice of square holes, screwed to the wall over a dark opening, front -Y. Black paint with dust and soot streaks, rusted screw heads. The back of the bounds is the wall face (0.03 m deep incl. the dark cavity box behind, which sits inside the wall); the bounds' bottom is the grille's lower edge (mount it high on a wall).

paint.prompt: small Victorian cast iron wall ventilator grille painted black, dusty, soot streaks, rusty screws
